scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:python"
scripts.dev:python: cd python-service && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --reload-dir app --port 8001
scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ../python-service && pip install -r requirements.txt && npm run setup:spotdl
scripts.setup:spotdl: cd python-service && if not exist venv-spotdl (python -m venv venv-spotdl) && venv-spotdl\Scripts\python -m pip install --upgrade spotdl
scripts.db:push: cd database && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: cd database && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.lint: cd client && npm run lint && cd ../server && npm run lint
scripts.typecheck: cd client && npm run typecheck && cd ../server && npm run typecheck
